purpose: Replace the rejected V44 abrupt blink source with matched V9-derived half-close, closed, and half-open eye components for a readable synchronized blink transition. This is source-only component art, not a face or animation sheet.

locked_v9_reference.use: sole visual reference for the fixed black V9 eye identity, scale, spacing, rounded ink weight and friendly restraint

reference_policy: The locked V9 sheet is the only image reference. V44 blink art is rejected evidence only and is not an image-generation input.

blink_contract.pairing: left/right matched, same baseline and synchronized
blink_contract.stages: open base face -> half_close pair -> closed pair -> half_open pair -> open base face
blink_contract.shape: temporary V9-derived eye-closure components only; preserve the same compact friendly eye grammar, no new emotion or eye identity
blink_contract.motion: visible entry and reopen transition, closed dwell 60-100 ms, each transition target 80-140 ms, post-blink settle target 900-1400 ms
blink_contract.native_target: each pair is independently registered at the V9 eye anchors and must remain within the original eye footprint; no brow, mouth, nose, cheek, highlight or sparkle source is included

native_review_gate.symmetry: each left/right stage pair has matched visual mass within 2 black pixels after mirror normalization
native_review_gate.stage_separation: half-close and half-open are visibly distinct from closed at native 200x200, while half-close and half-open retain the same V9 eye identity
native_review_gate.manual_visual_triage: reject full face, changed eye body grammar, lashes, winks, side-eye, sleep face, romance/sad eyes, text, labels, grid, border or device frame
